Method of Attack: Emotet is a banking trojan evolved into a botnet used to drop other malware strains like Trickbot and deliver Ryuk ransomware payloads
Discoverer: Australian Signals Directorate’s Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC)
Impacted Systems: Individuals, businesses, and government entities in U.S., Germany, U.K., Poland, Italy
Indicators of Compromise: 1,875 unique domains used in attacks covering over 400 TLDs
